- BV/TV assessed by micro-CT correlates with the percentage of bone assessed by conventional stereologic-based histomorphometry.
- Micro-CT is a reliable technique to determine the bone density and the microstructure of the maxillary alveolar bone at the site of dental implant insertion.

These findings suggest that micro-CT is capable of accurately assessing the microstructure of the maxillary alveolar bone, making it a valuable tool in orthopedic and oral surgical procedures.
